answer: Charge a bond that grows with how many accounts trace to the same funding source: the first account posts one unit, the second two, the third three, so n clones lock about n(n+1)/2 units while honest users post one. Like a prism splitting one beam, the funding trail splits visibly at the source, and a terrace of linked wallets stacks up cost step by step. Bonds flow back slowly, like a river, only after clean epochs.
